title: Book Two · Chapter 151: Two Places
story:
The school gate is open again. Ronan walks through it with a new exercise book under his arm. He is thirteen and a half. His trousers are longer now, but the bottom of one leg still catches under his shoe.

Leo points down. “Your clothes want to go home.”

“They can wait until lunch.”

Ronan pulls the cloth clear. They go toward the reading room. Through its window, he can see two empty chairs at the small desk.

The notice for the reading materials group is beside the door. There will be two full members. They will prepare simple information for younger students. They will also explain how to use the room.

Miss Wu brings out a second sheet.

“Please read the whole page,” she says. “Some of you saw the first notice before the holiday. This sheet gives the practice rules.”

Ronan steps closer and reads the sheet. There will be six practice tasks. Students can ask for help during practice. The teacher will record that help.

Miss Wu points to the next line. “You need at least four good independent results. You must do four or more tasks well without help.”

“Does that give us a place?” Ronan asks.

“It lets you take the final tasks,” she says. “Then we choose the two full members.”

“Does a fast answer count more?” a boy asks.

“A clear, correct answer counts. You also need to show the useful line on the page.”

Mei looks at the times. “The practice is after lessons?”

“On the days here. Please check your other plans first.”

Jun stands a little apart from Ronan. He reads the sheet, then writes a time in his own book.

“Are you trying?” Ronan asks him.

“I will come to some practice. I also have my drawing work.”

“We could look at the first page together.”

Jun closes his book. “I am working with Mei today.”

“All right.”

Ronan makes room for him to pass. Two years ago, Ronan gave Jun a false answer about the room's opening time. Ronan remembers the small booklets and the younger students outside a closed door. Jun does not need to say any of that now.

Leo reads the notice once more.

“Four out of six,” he says. “That leaves room for two bad days.”

Ronan looks at the two chairs. “I want to do all six well.”

“Me too.”

Leo does not smile at his own words. He wants one of the two places too.

Miss Wu takes their names. Ronan gives his own name clearly. Then he asks for a copy of the rules.

At lunch, he opens the copy beside his food. He moves it away before the first drop of soup reaches the corner.

“A fine start,” Leo says. “You are keeping the rules dry.”

Ronan laughs. He folds the sheet once and puts it inside his new book. Then he picks up his spoon.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

independent＝独立完成的；result＝结果；at least＝至少；make room＝让出空间。

## 理解问题

1. 六次练习中至少几次要独立合格？达到这个条件，是获正式席位还是进入最终选拔？
2. Jun怎样表达自己目前的边界？

## 读句子

**You also need to show the useful line on the page.**

拆开看：You / also need / to show the useful line on the page.

你／还需要／指出页面上有用的那一行。
